ITEM 1 | Mixed salad greens: broad flat green leaves (spinach-like, dark to mid green, some with lighter veins), plus frilly lettuce leaves with lighter green edges and ruffled texture, spread across most of the bowl, matte, slightly moist, leaves about 5-10 cm long | 85
ITEM 2 | Dark reddish-purple leaves (red leaf lettuce or chicory-like), crinkled and mostly intermixed under the greens on the lower right and bottom, matte, slightly wilted, pieces about 3-6 cm | 25
ITEM 3 | Thinly sliced red onion rings and half-rings, translucent pinkish-purple with white inner layers, glossy and moist, scattered across the center and right side, pieces about 4-6 cm long and 0.2-0.3 cm thick | 20
ITEM 4 | Avocado slice pieces: pale green flesh with yellowish-green tones, smooth, slightly glossy, soft, in a crescent-shaped wedge about 6 cm long and 1.5 cm thick, sitting on the right side of the greens | 25
ITEM 5 | Yellow-green frilly curly leaves (endive-like or frisée-like), pale yellow centers, sparse, scattered near the top right and center, pieces about 3-5 cm | 8
